title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for right breast cancer.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y/o female presenting for routine oncology follow-up. Pt is currently receiving chemotherapy for a malignant neoplasm of the right breast. She reports feeling generally well but notes mild fatigue. No new symptoms reported. She denies any systemic complaints.

Medication List
- Cyclophosphamide/Doxorubicin (Cycle 3)
- Ondansetron 8mg PRN for N/V
- Multivitamin daily

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: CTAB, no wheezing.
Skin: No new lesions noted.
Breast: Stable appearance of right breast.
Vitals: BP 122/78, HR 74, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Right breast cancer: Pt is currently receiving chemotherapy. No distant spread noted at this time.

Plan
1. Continue current chemo regimen.
2. Monitor for side effects.
3. F/u in 3 weeks for next cycle.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
10/15/2026
explanations: Cancer of the right female breast under current treatment is a current malignancy: C50.911.

distractors.why: Treatment is still directed at the cancer, so it is current, not history.
The note documents the right breast: use the right-breast code.
